name: card-feature
issues: The Figma layer is named "grid container/uniform", the same as the Read Next section already in the lab (prompts-footer-section). This one is a single full-width feature card (eyebrow, heading, text, arrow) over a chart, so it is its own component, named for the card. The chart is a raster fill drawn darker onto the card colour (multiply, 25%) with two soft blobs of the card colour over it to keep the text clear; both are approximated from the frame, so check them against Figma.
The card has an image slot (a wireframe placeholder in the Figma component) that this import fills with the chart seen in the frame.
